0.description: [Requires Launcher Update] The Hero Architect will now wait for you to leave combat before auto learning new spells.

[Requires Launcher Update] Improved the sorting of searching in Character Advancement. Known spells and talents are now always at the top of the list. Spells and Talents that are too high level for you are always at the bottom of the list.
[Requires Launcher Update] [Mal'Ganis] Spells in the search box for Character Advancement now have an icon and cost number for their quality, similar to the Talent Essence / Ability Essence counters
[Requires Launcher Update] [Mal'Ganis] You can now click on the spell quality counters in the bottom right of Character Advancement to quickly search for spells with that quality.
Crow's Cache now only has 1 Spawn Location per event, and it now has cross-map POIs. There will be more changes to follow up with this!
Bear form is now uncommon quality from rare quality.
Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina is now a 32 Slot Quiver (Up from 18)

Fixed an issue that has been present on Ascension for years, where aggro range was not calculated properly. It was being calculated from the center point of the mob rather than the outer circle. Greatly diminishing the intended aggro range of mobs. We will be reviewing dungeons and making the needed changes to ensure this fix makes sense!

1.description: [Pending Restart] Concussive Barrage slow now lasts for 3 sec, changed from 4.
[Pending Restart] Unending Fury no longer increases the duration of Intercept.
[Pending Restart] Intercept now lasts for 3 sec, changed from 2.
[Requires Launcher Update] Heroic Leap now has a 50 second cooldown, changed from 60, and it now slows targets in radius by 50% for 2 sec.
[Malganis][Requires Launcher Update] Charge now has a 16 second cooldown, changed from to 18.
[Pending Restart] Tree of Life HoT mana reduction now affects Efflorescence.
[Pending Restart] Nature's Rejuvenation now affects Efflorescence.
[Pending Restart] Efflorescence now costs 8% base mana, changed from no cost.
[Pending Restart] Revitalize now also has a 5/10/15% chance to trigger from Efflorescence.
[Pending Restart] Nature's Splendor Capstone now also increases the duration of Efflorescence by 2 sec.
[Pending Restart] Nature's Splendor now increases the healing of Efflorescence by 2/4/6 sec.
[Pending Restart] Invocation now shares a cooldown with Holy Shield and Shield Block.
[Pending Restart] Shield Block is now also usable while in Righteous Fury, and now shares a cooldown with Holy Shield and Invocation.
[Pending Restart] Holy Shield is now also usable while in Defensive Stance, and now shares a cooldown with Shield Block and Invocation.
The Infected Mossflayer when tamed can no longer use Withered Touch or a stun. (These were not intended to be usable by tamed pets.)
[Pending restart] Fixed an issue where the Spell Power Capstone effect could trigger also when above 50% mana.

7.description: [Knight of the Eclipse] Fixed an issue with incorrect scaling on lower ranked spells.
[Pending Restart] Revitalize now also has a 5% chance to trigger from Efflorescence.
[Pending Restart] Efflorescence now works with Gift of Nature.
[Blood Venom] Blood Venom now increases the damage your target takes from your poisons by 33%, increased from 25%.
[Cauterizing Flames] Fixed Cauterizing Fire having incorrect range values. The spell now correctly shares Fireball's range.
Fixed an issue where the exponential combo point scaling on Winds of Winter was not also increasing the PvP mod per combo point spent.
Fixed an issue where Seal of Fervor and Judgement of Fervor did not have a PvP mod.
[Blood Venom] Reduced poison damage increase to 25% from 40% to bring the DPS of this build more inline with other competing specs.
[Dark Surgeon] Dark Transfusion Heal can now heal up to 6 nearby raid members instead of being restricted to party members.
[Dark Surgeon] Fixed an issue where Dark Transfusion Heal had incorrect scaling on lower ranks.
[Elemental Destruction] Fixed an issue where Elemental Immolation had incorrect scaling on lower ranks.
[Snowblind] Ice Prism can now be dispelled.
[Tree of Wrath]  Tree of Wrath now correctly benefits from Tree of Life talents and effects.
[Tree of Wrath]  Increased the Nature Spell Power gained from Healing Power to 30% from 20%

[Tree of Wrath Rework]  Chain Heal also teaches you Living Lightning. Living Lightning heals your target, then jumps to nearby allies, splitting into a Chain Lightning with each jump. Living Lightning deals $86439s1% damage to your Lightning Rod Target. This spell has an increased cooldown. Critically healing with Lesser Healing Wave, Healing Wave and Chain Heal reduce the cooldown by 4 second.

[Tree of Wrath Rework]  While in Tree of Wrath your lightning bolt applies Lightning Rod to your target for 10 seconds. Only one target can be affected by Lightning Rod at a time. When you critically heal another player with a direct nature healing spell in Tree of Wrath, you will cast lightning bolt on your lightning Rod target.

[Tree of Wrath Rework]  Tree of Life is transformed into Tree of Wrath, which increases your Nature Spell Power by 30% of your Bonus Healing. Your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning cannot miss while in this form.

1.description: [Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where Holy Shield did not show its Righteous Fury requirement correctly.
Create Soulstone now costs 1 Rare Essence, changed from 2.
Reincarnation now costs 1 Rare Essence, changed from 2.
Rebirth now costs 1 Rare Essence, changed from 2.
[Pending Restart] Surefooted now has a new capstone: With the final rank of this talent, using Disengage will clear any Slow effects on you.
[Pending Restart] Survival Tactics now reduces the cooldown of Disengage by 2/4/6 sec, changed from 3/6/9. The capstone has been removed (and is now in the Surefooted talent).
[Pending Restart] Corrected an issue where Burning Determination still lasted for 15 sec. It will now last for 10 sec as intended.
Capacitor Totem now takes 2 sec to stun, changed from 1 sec.

0.description: [League III] Applied item buffs from 7 to 14% for some items stats in mythic 60 dungeons.
[League III] Applied item buffs from 8% to 16% for some item stats in heroic 60 dungeons.
[League III] Applied item buffs from 12 to 25% for some item stats in normal 51-60 dungeons.
Withered Touch damage, which certain undead pets use, has been set extremely low in PvP as a temporary measure. (It will be removed on next server restart as it is not intended to be a pet spell).

Fixed a numerous amount of silences and interrupts that could interrupt Mana-Forged barrier. When reporting these issues to the bugtracker, please include the mob or spell name that interrupted you. The intention is to not allow players to bypass important raid mechanics but to be immune to most common interrupts that are casted by bosses, dungeon mobs, etc.
[World Bosses] [League III] World Boss Spawn Timer has been reduced significantly.
Fixed an issue where players sometimes would not get arena rating after queing 2v2.
Devlin Agamand's Frostbolt now requires 7% of base mana from 10% of their base mana. This is brought closer towards Banshee Wail and similar spells that cost 4 to 5% of base mana.

[Pending Restart] Lowered the additional PvP mod on Thunder Clap to 10% from 20% when using the Thunder Slam enchantment as fixing the issue where scaling from Nature damage also removed the Stormstrike Bonus from Thunder Clap's damage.
[League III] Fixed an issue where Divine Fury could not be extracted.

[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Random Enchantments like Flame Surge and Dusk till Dawn would cause multiple hits to the same targets and multi-hits to the two targets. Additionally, this change now allows for Flame Surge and Dusk Till Dawn to hit all 10 / 5 targets (respectively) compared to only previously being able to hit 5 / 3 targets 2 times each (respectively)

[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where some undead and demon pets would have more abilities than they were supposed too. This created a dynamic where similar pets would not scale the same nor have the same abilities causing you to always run one type of pet.

8.description: Pending restart, fixed an issue where the Path to Ascension: Building Your Class Fantasy could not be turned it at the Call Board.
Pending restart, fixed an issue where the Horde had no Call to Arms: Battleground quest available on the Call Board.

[Area 52] [Pending Restart] Player are now able to accept and complete quests leading to and are started by Commander Ameer in Netherstorm, allowing player to complete all quests associated with Ethereum Nexus Prisons, including those located in Blades Edge Mountain and the Mana-Tombs dungeon.

6.description: [Malganis] [Zul Gurub] Mandokir Ghosts will now respawn at their initial position. After killing a player the ghost will now disappear.
[Area 52] [The Mana-Tombs] [Pending Restart] Requires Cache to be cleared for visual changes - Adjusted Stats of some of Yors items to Mythic standards.

[Area 52] [The Mana-Tombs] [Pending Restart] Player are now able to acquire Shaffars Nexus Prison Key and The Eye of Haramad whish can open the Prison Chamber in the last room of the dungeon to summon Yor, the Voidhound of Shaffar on Heroic and Mythic difficulty.

0.description: [Malganis] Renew now has common rarity, changed from rare.
[Malganis] Rejuvenation now has common rarity, changed from rare.
[Malganis] Doubled honor rate gains.
[Requires Launcher Update] Auto-learned abilities from the Hero Architect now have a clickable link to the active build that learned them.
[Requires Launcher Update] Your active build now has a unique border, and will now always be the first build in the list in it's category in the Hero Architect.
[Requires Launcher Update] If you have a build active in the Hero Architect, there is now a separate category button below "New Builds" which will link directly to your current spec's active build.
Smoldering Companion (Epic Enchant) is now usable on Tamable Undead and Demons.
Glacial Companion (Epic Enchant) is now usable on Tamable Undead and Demons.
Adumbral Companion (Epic Enchant) is now usable on Tamable Undead and Demons.
Voltaic Companion (Epic Enchant) is now usable on Tamable Undead and Demons.
Mystic Companion (Epic Enchant) is now usable on Tamable Undead and Demons.
Fixed an issue that would cause low level players to have specializations duplicated.
You can now change your ruleset in the open world from level 20 to 25 with a cooldown. This solves an issue where you were unable to change rulesets if you levelled from 19 to 21.

1.description: [Arcane Gunslinger] Gunslinger Barrage will no longer consume ammo. Pending Restart.
[Pending Restart] Mana-forged Barrier will no longer be removed when hit by a mind-controlled player.
[Pending Restart] [Pending Patch Update] - Brilliance Aura will no longer trigger the visual and sound everytime you gain mana from the ability.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Combustion was giving double the crit damage bonus.
[Pending restart] Shield of Righteousness is now useable while silenced.
Fixed an issue where the Shadow Reach talent wasn't visible. (Requires patch update through launcher.)

7.description: [Requires Launcher Update] Energy Bolt from Elemental Destruction now has a new visual effect.
[Pending Restart] Ice Prism now has a 30 yard range, changed from 40.
Ice Prism from the Snow Blind enchant now deals 25% less damage to players from 0%.
[Pending Restart] [Dark Surgeon] Increased the scaling from attack power and spell power of Dark Surgeon's Dark Transfusion.
[Pending Restart] [Dark Surgeon] Increased the scaling from attack power and spell power of Dark Surgeon's triggered circle of healing.
[Pending Restart] [Dark Surgeon] Increased the base healing of Dark Surgeon's triggered circle of healing at all levels.

[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Thunder Clap with Thunder Slam active was dealing Nature damage instead of physical damage. (This will reduce the damage it deals as it will no longer ignore armor.)
[Arcane Gunslinger] All ranks of Arcane Bullet now properly incur a cooldown when casted.
[Arcane Gunslinger] Fixed incorrect scaling at lower ranks of Arcane Bullet.
[Pending Restart] [Knight of the Eclipse] Solar Burn can now stack on the same target from multiple casters, allowing multiple players to use this effectively in the same raid.
[Pending Restart] [Knight of the Eclipse] Instant Casts triggered from Lunar Wrath and Solar Wrath deal less damage to players as intended.
[Pending Restart] [Lucifur] Charred Bite DoT effect can now stack on the same mob from multiple casters. This will allow more than one player to effectively play Lucifur in the same raid.
[Pending restart] Reduced the base damage of Ice Prism from Snowblind to reduce its power at lower levels.

8.description: [Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue with [Path to Ascension: Build Your Class Fantasy] not completing when choosing a build from the hero architect.
